housing-acadex-ff058617.housingText: Housing $105-119/week/person (*Rates are subject to change) ($15/day approximately for housing and meals.) Housing cost will be deducted from paychecks. Sheets and towels are provided. All employees must share a room with one roommate. Rooms are based on double occupancy. No single rooms are available. Most rooms have a shared bathroom with another room.All rooms are heated but do not come with air conditioning. Rooms are not equipped with phones Free internet access is available in the Employee Dining Room. Complimentary laundry facilities are available on site. There is also a central recreation room with tv, pool tables, foose ball, movie room, book library, scheduled activities, including trips to Wasilla and Anchorage and employee tour opportunities.Termination of job equals termination of housing. All employees must sign an employee housing agreement which outlines standards of conduct and rules for usage of employee housing. Employee housing privileges can be revoked for violations of housing and conduct standards.
